# Cheery — *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic* (G4)

Cheery is the tiny, exuberant *pink-lavender pegasus filly* cheering at the end of young Rainbow Dash’s Cloudsdale race. She is easiest to spot with her wings flung upward, mouth wide in delight, and a rainbow behind her. She has a very pale pink-lilac coat, pink mane and tail, pink-violet eyes, and no visible cutie mark. Her hairstyle resembles several other background fillies. [G4 foal index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Foals)

**Name and status.** “Cheery” is a fandom/wiki identification, not a verified name spoken in the show or established by an official credit. A [Spanish-language character entry](https://mlp.fandom.com/es/wiki/Cheery) explains the nickname as a reference to her enthusiastic, pom-pom-like cheering. She is distinct from Cheerilee, Ponyville’s earth-pony schoolteacher, who has also sometimes been nicknamed “Cheery.” [Cheerilee character entry](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Cheerilee)

**Speaking and appearances.** No individually identifiable dialogue or credited voice actor was verified for this filly; crowd cheering is not evidence of a specific actor. Her one verified screen appearance is *The Cutie Mark Chronicles* (season 1, episode 23, aired April 15, 2011), in Rainbow Dash’s childhood flashback. No other appearances or alternate identities were verified.

**Show still —** *The Cutie Mark Chronicles*; production: Hasbro Studios / *My Little Pony: Friendship Is Magic*. Cropped episode capture hosted on Derpibooru; no individual animator is established.

## Important moments

1. **Rainbow Dash’s first Sonic Rainboom — “The Cutie Mark Chronicles” (S1E23).** Cheery is among the young pegasi who witness the aftermath of the spectacular race, a breakthrough that connects the Mane Six’s cutie-mark stories. [Official full episode on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JHUzbrxbzv4) — exact scene timestamp not independently verified.
2. **The joyful victory cheer — “The Cutie Mark Chronicles” (S1E23).** Her delighted expression and raised wings are the distinctive instant that prompted fans to call this background filly “Cheery”; this is another beat of the *same* scene, not a separate adventure. [Full episode on Tubi](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200198859/s01-e23-the-cutie-mark-chronicles) — timestamp unavailable.
